title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸
summary: 從單層與晶粒、轉移殘留到晶圓可製造性：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Monolayer and grains and Transfer residue to Wafer manufacturability: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 單層與晶粒 → 暫時載板
stages.titleEn: Monolayer and grains to Temporary carrier
stages.description: 把「單層與晶粒」「成長與轉移」「暫時載板」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Monolayer and grains, Growth and transfer, Temporary carrier.

steps.title: 單層與晶粒：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects.
steps.instruction: 畫單層厚度、晶粒邊界與覆蓋率，分開三種品質指標。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Separate monolayer thickness, grain boundaries and coverage in a sketch. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷；晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界。
steps.observationEn: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects; Grain orientation changes boundary character.
steps.failure: 若採用「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「單層與晶粒」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Monolayer and grains diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects.

knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「二維半導體轉移與接觸」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「單層與晶粒：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：高局部遷移率不代表轉移後大面積均勻與低接觸電阻。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「特殊元件工坊：功率、光電與 MEMS」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：二維半導體轉移與接觸 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「高局部遷移率不代表轉移後大面積均勻與低接觸電阻」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts as the task boundary. After reading “Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: High local mobility does not prove large-area transfer uniformity or low contact resistance. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Special-device workshop: power, optoelectronics and MEMS”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “High local mobility does not prove large-area transfer uniformity or low contact resistance” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「單層與晶粒」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Monolayer and grains, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷
全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同
可在基板成長就能原樣搬到完成晶片
optionsEn: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects
Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere
Moving a growth process unchanged to completed chips
quiz.explanation: 連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 單層與晶粒：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monolayer and grains: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「單層與晶粒」成果，先指出錯誤主張「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Monolayer and grains artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Grain orientation changes boundary character. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷；晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界。
steps.observationEn: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects; Grain orientation changes boundary character.
steps.failure: 若採用「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「單層與晶粒」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Monolayer and grains, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Grain orientation changes boundary character" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 單層與晶粒／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Monolayer and grains / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」與「連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
